scope: Source-only incremental v2 review closing v1 limiter race; no test/JAR/SDK execution.

resolvedV1Findings.issue: Expired row could be pruned after lookup but before that borrowed row was reset/admitted.
resolvedV1Findings.resolution: OwnedConcurrentWindows.admit validates the actual BaseSource environment, Host scope and existing task deadline before taking records lock. Lookup, expired pruning, new insertion and original existing-row counter update now all occur inside that same records critical section. No new owner can detach an already-borrowed row between lookup and admission.
resolvedV1Findings.originalSemantics: Malformed/null/zero parsing, accessLimit/frequency, interval/reset and retry-delay logic remain the original window algorithm; cap256 still refuses adding an owner rather than evicting a live window.
resolvedV1Findings.reviewResult: Confirmed v1 race closed statically; original failing version and review remain historical.

encapsulation.finding: The records field moved out of the companion into its own same-file private object. All accesses originate inside that object; no source method returns the Map and no synthetic accessor is needed for outer/companion cross-access. The remaining callable admit takes BaseSource and validates the real Host scope itself, not caller-provided raw scope.

encapsulation.limits: This closes the specific callable/synthetic Map exposure, not a new general hostile-JVM reflection sandbox claim.
